tasks.label: docker: build image (release + sha)
tasks.command: $IMAGE_REPO = "docker-private.repository.itools.radwarecloud.com/anatolyb/mcp-clickhouse"; $IMAGE_TAG = if ($env:IMAGE_TAG) { $env:IMAGE_TAG } else { "1.0.0" }; $IMAGE_SHA = (git rev-parse --short HEAD).Trim(); docker build -t "$IMAGE_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG" -t "$IMAGE_REPO:$IMAGE_SHA" .

tasks.label: docker: push image (release + sha)
tasks.command: $IMAGE_REPO = "docker-private.repository.itools.radwarecloud.com/anatolyb/mcp-clickhouse"; $IMAGE_TAG = if ($env:IMAGE_TAG) { $env:IMAGE_TAG } else { "1.0.0" }; $IMAGE_SHA = (git rev-parse --short HEAD).Trim(); docker push "$IMAGE_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG"; docker push "$IMAGE_REPO:$IMAGE_SHA"

tasks.label: helm: lint and template

tasks.label: helm: deploy localdev
tasks.command: $IMAGE_REPO = "docker-private.repository.itools.radwarecloud.com/anatolyb/mcp-clickhouse"; $IMAGE_TAG = if ($env:IMAGE_TAG) { $env:IMAGE_TAG } else { "1.0.0" }; helm upgrade --install mcp-clickhouse helm/mcp-clickhouse --namespace localdev --create-namespace --set image.repository=$IMAGE_REPO --set image.tag=$IMAGE_TAG

tasks.label: k8s: smoke check localdev
tasks.command: $envFile = '.env.local'; if (Test-Path $envFile) { Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { $line = $_.Trim(); if ($line -and -not $line.StartsWith('#')) { $kv = $line -split '=', 2; if ($kv.Count -eq 2) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($kv[0].Trim(), $kv[1].Trim(), 'Process') } } } }; if ($env:KUBECONFIG -like '$*') { $refName = $env:KUBECONFIG.Substring(1); $resolved = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($refName, 'Process'); if ($resolved) { $env:KUBECONFIG = $resolved } }; kubectl -n localdev rollout status deployment/mcp-clickhouse; kubectl -n localdev get pods,svc

tasks.label: k8s: validate mcp localdev
tasks.command: $envFile = '.env.local'; if (Test-Path $envFile) { Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { $line = $_.Trim(); if ($line -and -not $line.StartsWith('#')) { $kv = $line -split '=', 2; if ($kv.Count -eq 2) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($kv[0].Trim(), $kv[1].Trim(), 'Process') } } } }; if ($env:KUBECONFIG -like '$*') { $refName = $env:KUBECONFIG.Substring(1); $resolved = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($refName, 'Process'); if ($resolved) { $env:KUBECONFIG = $resolved } }; kubectl -n localdev rollout status deployment/mcp-clickhouse --timeout=420s; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $pod = kubectl -n localdev get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=mcp-clickhouse --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -o jsonpath='{.items[-1].metadata.name}'; if (-not $pod) { Write-Error 'No mcp-clickhouse pod found'; exit 1 }; $ready = kubectl -n localdev get pod $pod -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].ready}'; if ($ready -ne 'true') { Write-Error "Pod $pod is not ready"; exit 1 }; Write-Output "POD=$pod READY=$ready"; kubectl -n localdev exec $pod -- python -c "import urllib.request; u='http://127.0.0.1:8000/health'; r=urllib.request.urlopen(u, timeout=20); print('HEALTH_STATUS', r.getcode()); print(r.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $recentLogs = kubectl -n localdev logs $pod --since=2m; if ($recentLogs -match 'Failed to connect to ClickHouse|Health check failed|503 Service Unavailable') { Write-Error 'Recent logs contain MCP/ClickHouse health failures'; exit 1 }; Write-Output 'MCP_VALIDATION_OK'
